## ResourceDescriptor.parents property

The resources whose objects contain this one, per resolving operation: `get` when the app gets one of this resource only within such an object, taking its identifier along with the object's own; `list` when it lists them only within one.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly parents?: ResourceParents;
```

## Remarks

Absent when both operations work at the application. A reference resolved through an operation with a parent (a single-object reference, a container or an identity-collection entry through `get`<!-- -->; a selector collection through `list`<!-- -->) must carry as its container an identity reference to an object of that parent, which supplies the parent identifier. Encoding, the wire schema and `bindReference` reject one without it.
